scope: First live ODE pair; visible adapted text versus rendered source pages and extracted text. No independent mathematics solving.

claude.reason: Only one of eight worked-example starting equations appears in visible lesson text; most worked equations, calculation lines and final results are omitted. Ambiguous extracted constant/root labels are replaced with numbered subscripts that the rendered source cannot verify.

openai.reason: No worked-example starting equation appears in visible lesson text. Many steps direct the learner to the original instead of supplying the source calculations; source panels are not rendered in current ADAPT UI. It acknowledges obscured labels rather than guessing them.

sourceLimitations: Poppler reports missing display fonts. Some Greek/subscript glyphs on pages 4–7 are not reliably legible in the render; intended replacements were not inferred.
Equation-presence checks ignore whitespace only and assess display text, not hidden evidence. They are omission signals, not proof of total semantic fidelity.
decision: No repeat generations and no 28-page experiment. Both strict validators pass, but correctness/completeness gate fails; OpenAI has no observed provider latency advantage.

practiceReview.strictValidation: Both five-question responses pass current strict validator and HTTP handler.
semanticLimitations: OpenAI lesson Q1 asks order and degree; feedback selected only the order statement.
OpenAI lesson Q4 asks integrating-factor expression and effect; selected paragraph supplies the effect but no expression.
Claude lesson Q2 asks rearrangement and solving; feedback selected only the rearrangement.
